about: Persona block format, version 1. A block is one small, typed piece of a character that anyone can reuse. Combine blocks in Studio to make a new character. A character is a recipe that points to blocks by address, so remixes keep their family tree.
address: type@name/vN, e.g. face@sienna/v2 (set by Persona when you publish)
type: one of: face, body, hair, wardrobe, camera, light, location, mood, pose
name: short lowercase name with dashes, e.g. sienna or golden-hour. The first person to publish a name owns it; new versions keep the name.
version: 1, 2, 3... (set by Persona). A published version never changes.
title: Display name, e.g. Sienna
author: who made it (set by Persona)
preview: https:// link to a preview image
remix_of: address of the block this one was remixed from, e.g. face@sienna/v1 (keeps the family tree)
likeness: faces only: must be "invented". Faces of real people or celebrities are not allowed.

character_recipe_example.name: Lena Noir
included: full copies of each block, so the file works anywhere
